LO 4.1A: Determine whether a
series converges or diverges.
EK 4.1A6: In addition to examining the
limit of the sequence of partial sums of the
series, methods for determining whether a
series of numbers converges or diverges are
the nth term test, the comparison test, the
limit comparison test, the integral test, the
ratio test, and the alternating series test.
